INSERT INTO BID_CASES (BID_CASE_ID, INSTITUTION_ID, SCHEDULE_CONFIDENCE, EXPECTED_DATE, CONFIRMED_DATE, LAST_SYNCED_AT, PARTICIPATION_STATUS, PARTICIPATION_DECISION, RESEARCH_STATUS, SOURCE_SLUG, NOTICE_ID, TITLE, NOTICE_URL) VALUES (#{bidCaseId}, #{institutionId}, #{scheduleConfidence}, #{expectedDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{confirmedDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lastSyncedAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{participationStatus},
#{participationDecision,jdbcType=CLOB, typeHandler=com.kbstar.kgi.ggreport.web.mapper.handler.ParticipationDecisionTypeHandler}, #{researchStatus}, #{sourceSlug,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{noticeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{noticeUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.update:
UPDATE BID_CASES SET SCHEDULE_CONFIDENCE = #{confidence},
CONFIRMED_DATE = COALESCE(#{date,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONFIRMED_DATE),
EXPECTED_DATE = COALESCE(#{date,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXPECTED_DATE),
TITLE = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOTICE_URL = #{noticeUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LAST_SYNCED_AT = #{lastSyncedAt,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BID_CASE_ID = #{bidCaseId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT BC.BID_CASE_ID, BC.INSTITUTION_ID, BC.SCHEDULE_CONFIDENCE, BC.EXPECTED_DATE, BC.CONFIRMED_DATE, BC.LAST_SYNCED_AT, BC.PARTICIPATION_STATUS, BC.PARTICIPATION_DECISION, BC.RESEARCH_STATUS, BC.FINALIZED_BY, BC.FINALIZED_AT, BC.SOURCE_SLUG, BC.NOTICE_ID, BC.TITLE, BC.NOTICE_URL FROM BID_CASES BC JOIN TASKS T ON T.BID_CASE_ID = BC.BID_CASE_ID WHERE T.TEAM = #{team} AND T.ASSIGNEE = #{assignee} ORDER BY BC.BID_CASE_ID
SELECT FROM BID_CASES WHERE BID_CASE_ID IN (SELECT BID_CASE_ID FROM TASKS WHERE TEAM = #{team} AND ASSIGNEE = #{assignee}) ORDER BY BID_CASE_ID
SELECT FROM BID_CASES WHERE SEQ_NO IN (SELECT MAX(SEQ_NO) FROM BID_CASES GROUP BY INSTITUTION_ID) ORDER BY INSTITUTION_ID
SELECT BID_CASE_ID FROM BID_CASES WHERE INSTITUTION_ID = #{institutionId} AND PARTICIPATION_STATUS = '참여확정' AND RESEARCH_STATUS = '대기'
